_doc: fc-negative-004: 'tools present but irrelevant' (arithmetic). The user asks a math question; the available tools are all filesystem and can't compute. The model should answer '391' in prose, not call any tool. Tests the 'no tool fits' pattern again with a different domain mismatch.
prompt: What's 17 * 23? Just give me the number.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the full text contents of a file at the given absolute path. Returns the file contents as a UTF-8 string, or an error if the file does not exist or is not readable.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to read, e.g. /etc/hostname

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write a UTF-8 string to a file at the given absolute path, overwriting any existing contents.

function.name: delete_file
function.description: Delete a file at the given absolute path. Irreversible. Returns an error if the file does not exist, if the path is a directory, or if the caller lacks write permission.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to delete

function.name: copy_file
function.description: Copy a file from `src` to `dst`. Creates `dst`'s parent directories if they don't already exist. Overwrites `dst` if it exists.

src.description: Absolute path of the source file

dst.description: Absolute path of the destination file
